about_the_game:
Sector Assault is a revolution of the classic Asteroids formula. In this inspired twist, your mission is to defeat an enemy armada with weapons and tactics as varied as your own. Your battle across the sector will include...

14 Powerful Loadout Options

Wield any combination of four weapons and equipment. Fire swarms of missiles, get up close and personal with the Scattershot, or zap enemies from behind cover with Chain Lightning. Equipment offers even more tactical flexibility than weapons. Teleport, stun high-priority targets, or project an energy field that boosts ramming damage.

16 Deadly Enemies and Their Variants

The opposing fleet includes everything from phased cruise missiles to raiders that teleport in and out of play. Evade mobile mines and sweeping lasers as you exchange fire with heavily armed and armored juggernauts. Supercharged variants fire their special attacks continuously, allowing even basic enemies to fill your screen with projectiles.

30 Waves of Finely Crafted Mayhem

Enemies are capable of warping in formation or surrounding you without warning. Testing your reflexes further are endless combinations that complement each other or overwhelm with brute force. Even in the middle of the chaos, spawn timings are fine-tuned to ensure a smooth and satisfying pace.

The Sublime Beauty of Deep Space

Sector Assault's backgrounds have been selected from thousands of randomly generated combinations. Each one is streaked with vibrant nebulas and given parallaxing for added depth. Music and sound effects were handpicked with equal care to further enhance the game's atmosphere.

Choose your loadouts wisely and adapt faster than the enemy to achieve your mission of securing the sector!
